info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Trading Workbench API
info.description: The E-Trading Workbench API provides essential tools for managing and monitoring investment activities within a trading environment. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about trading operations by utilizing specific parameters. Typical consumers include investment managers, traders, and financial analysts who require real-time insights into their trading positions and activities. With this API, users can streamline their trading processes and enhance decision-making capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific e-trading workbench identified by its unique ID. It provides essential information necessary for managing and operating within the investment management domain.

requestBody.description: The request body for the GET operation on the e-trading workbench. This body must contain the required parameters in JSON format, as specified by the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested e-trading workbench data.

GetInvestmentManagementETradingWorkbench.description: Represents the JSON request body for retrieving operations in the trading workbench.

GetInvestmentManagementETradingWorkbench.title: Investment Management Response

investmentAccountId.description: The unique identifier for the investment account.

investmentObjective.description: The investment objective of the portfolio.

baseCurrency.description: The base currency for the portfolio.

GetInvestmentManagementETradingWorkbench.description: Represents the response structure for the operations involved in retrieving investment management data.
